page-title.purpose: One per page, in .page-head. Plus Jakarta Sans 600/24px.

body-lg.purpose: Record titles, primary row text, the v4 capture-row dish name and summary-rule values.

body.purpose: Base body, table cells, meta. Equals the html base size.

control.purpose: Buttons, inputs, selects, tabs — controls run 13.5px.

label.purpose: Pill and field labels, dense metadata, the v4 summary-rule labels and row status.

mono.purpose: SF Mono. Machine IDs and codes only — never a costume for 'technical'.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: The one resting lift. Cards, KPI tiles, kanban cards ONLY — co-signs the 1px border, never replaces it (OD-P3-11). Flat utility surfaces (toolbars, rows, strips, the v4 summary rule) get none.

shadows.name: state-lift
shadows.purpose: Card or KPI tile on hover — deepens from rest.

shadows.name: kanban-hover
shadows.purpose: Draggable kanban card on hover; lifts more because it is grabbable.

shadows.name: brand-button
shadows.purpose: Faint brand-tinted lift under the primary button.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default control state easing. Motion here is a response to state, never decoration.

breakpoints.name: phone-toolbar
breakpoints.purpose: v4: below this the Café toolbar keeps search + category on one line instead of wrapping.

breakpoints.name: table-reflow
breakpoints.purpose: DataTable switches between the desktop <table> and phone cards (OD-W4-4). Exactly one branch renders.

breakpoints.name: rail-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: The desktop rail collapses. Distinct from table-reflow — do not conflate the two.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action affordance. The One Blue, kept under ~10% of any screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 8px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 25%, transparent); transition: background .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered neutral action. Discard, Cancel, and every non-primary verb.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--secondary); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: The toolbar search-mini. Single border, 8px control radius, One-Blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input-search { height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 13px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input-search:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--ring); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: 6px dot plus tinted background and darkened text. For SPARSE or exceptional status only — see Row Status Text when the status is on every row.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 12%, transparent); color: var(--status-lost-text, var(--destructive)); } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; flex: none; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Border AND the one resting shadow — co-equal, never shadow-alone (Soft-Elevation Rule).
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(222 18% 12% / 0.05), 0 1px 3px hsl(222 18% 12% / 0.04); transition: box-shadow .2s; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 10px hsl(240 6% 10% / 0.06); }

components.name: Rail Nav Item
components.description: Destination row in the two-zone rail. Active state is a quiet wash, not a blue fill.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: none; font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--secondary); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: var(--secondary); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Metric Summary Rule
components.description: v4 signature. The derived-figure band for surfaces whose job is DOING, not reading. One line, no card, no shadow, hairline underneath. Replaces the KPI tile row on capture surfaces.

components.css: .ds-summary-rule { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 22px; row-gap: 6px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-metric { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 7px; } .ds-metric-label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-metric-value { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--foreground); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric-delta { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--destructive); white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Compact Capture Row
components.description: v4 signature. The phone row for running a long list and acting on each item. Identity left, TYPED numeric field right at the thumb, meta line beneath that renders only when it has something to say. ~66px against the generic record card's ~200px. The control is a typed field, NOT a stepper: amounts here are 10-20+, so -/+ meant ~20 taps per row (owner-corrected, DD-5). font-size is 16px so mobile Safari does not zoom the viewport on focus.

components.css: .ds-capture-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; } .ds-capture-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-capture-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--foreground); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-capture-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-capture-status { color: var(--status-lost-text); font-weight: 500; } .ds-qty-wrap { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex: none; } .ds-qty { width: 68px; height: 44px; box-sizing: border-box; text-align: right; padding-right: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-family: inherit; } .ds-qty::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-qty:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-qty-unit { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Segmented Track
components.description: extract (2026-07-28): promoted from two pixel-identical re-authorings (Money's Branch/Activity CutToggle and Home's order-preference toggle). One visual grammar, TWO ARIA shapes on top of it — a role=tablist view-switcher (aria-selected state) and a role=radiogroup persistent setting (.is-active state) — because the interaction contracts genuinely differ even though the paint doesn't. Canonical CSS: src/styles/segmented-track.css, @import'ed by both consumers.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; height: 32px; padding: 3px; background: var(--secondary); border-radius: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-seg-opt { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg-opt[aria-selected='true'] { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-font-color-primary) 12%, transparent); }

narrative.overview: A near-monochrome system whose only saturated colour in normal use is the primary blue. Status colours appear only on data state, and a single categorical violet is reserved for KPI and timeline accents — never as an action colour. Structure comes from one 1px border and surface-tone contrast, plus one subtle resting lift on cards. The system is calm, dense and data-first: it is meant to be looked at all day by people who came to get something done, on a café floor or at a desk.
keyCharacteristics: One blue for every interactive affordance, under ~10% of any screen
One border value; structure by line and tone, not by shadow
Exactly one resting shadow, on cards/KPI/kanban only
Tabular figures on every number that can be compared
Density is a feature — usability and speed beat model completeness
Colour is rationed to what needs action

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Every interactive affordance uses the one primary blue, kept under ~10% of any screen. The primary-button sheen is the same blue, not a second action colour.

rules.name: The Single-Border Rule
rules.body: border equals input. One border value defines all structure.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every figure that can change or be compared is tabular-nums. DM Sans tnum is a verified no-op in its fontsource build, so the .tabular utility is scoped to Inter Variable; proportional body text stays DM Sans.

rules.name: The Soft-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Cards, KPI tiles and kanban cards carry exactly one subtle resting shadow in addition to their 1px border. Every other surface stays flat at rest. Never stack resting shadows; never exceed ~0.06 total alpha (OD-P3-11).

rules.name: The Restrained-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Only the two ratified navy-tinted whispers: the primary-button sheen and the home/digest surface wash. Never purple (OD-P3-12).

rules.name: The Surface-Job Rule
rules.body: Pick the metric treatment from the surface's job: the summary rule where the user came to act, KPI tiles where they came to read. A capture surface never opens with a row of tiles (v4).

rules.name: The No-Restated-Value Rule
rules.body: Never repeat a value under a control that the row or card already renders as its own column or field (v4).

rules.name: The One-Definition Rule
rules.body: A CSS class name is global regardless of which component file declares it, so exactly one file may define any given selector. A second, differently-valued definition of the same class elsewhere in the app is not a harmless local override — it silently wins or loses the cascade by import order, not intent (extract, 2026-07-28: found live on four separate classes — .sr-only in four page/component files, and a dead .btn-ghost that was shadowing the canonical Button ghost variant app-wide). Shared visual grammar used by more than one component belongs in one file the consumers @import, not re-authored per surface.

dos: Do drive every interactive affordance with the one primary blue, and keep it under ~10% of any screen.
Do define structure with the single 1px border and surface-tone contrast; cards also carry the one subtle resting lift.
Do apply tabular-nums to every figure in tables, KPIs, kanban and funnels.
Do show status as a 6px dot plus a tinted pill, and reserve solid fills for the destructive button only.
Do keep controls at 32px with the 8px control radius; cards and overlays take the 12px card radius.
Do set headings in Plus Jakarta Sans 600 and body/UI/table text in DM Sans; SF Mono for machine IDs only.
Do expose the global focus-visible ring on every focusable element.
Do reserve categorical violet and the status hues for non-interactive meaning.
Do pick the metric treatment from the surface's job: the summary rule where the user came to act, KPI tiles where they came to read.
Do drop a status pill's fill to toned text when the status is present on every row at rest.
donts: Don't ship the AI-SaaS marketing aesthetic: no neon accents, no glassmorphism, no oversized hero type, no floating-card soup, no purple gradients.
Don't stack resting shadows or give a flat utility surface a resting shadow.
Don't use high-opacity black for shadows.
Don't introduce a second action colour, a fourth typeface, a new gradient hue, or a new border value.
Don't use mono or proportional figures for money in tables.
Don't colour body text with a fully saturated status hue or fill a status pill solid.
Don't invent radii outside the 4/8/10/12/999 scale.
Don't open a capture surface with a row of KPI tiles.
Don't repeat a value under a control that the row or card already renders as its own column or field.
Don't ship the generic record card on a surface whose phone job is running a long capture list.
